notes.title: Game content update instructions
notes.notes:
The game content has been updated for the first time

Updated a type of update (including three variants). When encountering this type of change, please do not get close. In certain cases, it will cause the game to fail without warning
The chandelier has been updated with three variants. Each variant causes range damage. In certain cases, if the player is within the specified range, it will cause the game to fail.

Thanks to the player "SIMENG" for his suggestions.

notes.title: Bug fix v1.0.2 (2025-02-22)
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue that the sound of the door opening and closing could be triggered on the side without a door on the 20th floor
Tested the issue that all abnormal achievements could not be triggered (not tested online)
